metadata.description: An explicit edge to firebase-server:build-base, NOT `^build`: `^build` would resolve to firebase-server:build, which depends on this very target -- a hard cycle. It also imports the SIBLING entry point @dereekb/firebase-server/model, spelled `firebase-server-model:build-base` (siblings compile into the same dist directory and have no `build` of their own). It further imports @dereekb/microsoft, its @dereekb/microsoft/nestjs child, and @dereekb/util/oidc, hence `microsoft:build` and `util:build`: cross-family deps are spelled as the other family's ROOT `build`, the only target that produces a finalized copy for TypeScript to resolve `exports` against.
